hero.name: Kevin De La Fuente
hero.subtitle: Java · Spring Boot · Next.js · React. I build custom web products — freelance and open to opportunities.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Systems Programming Analyst (Universidad Champagnat, 2025). I specialize in independently learning and applying modern technologies — from Spring Boot 4 and Docker to Prisma, NextAuth and Gemini AI — turning them into concrete solutions tailored to each client's needs.
about.p2: I work with two main stacks: Java + Spring Boot with a separate Next.js frontend, or fullstack Next.js with Prisma and Supabase. In both I integrate generative AI (Gemini), Cloudinary, deploy on Vercel/Railway with Docker, and apply security best practices on my own initiative.
about.p3: I use Claude and Gemini in parallel to design, code and model databases; Gemini is also integrated into the products (chatbots).

facts.focusValue: Fullstack — Java / Spring Boot · Next.js / React

catan.name: Catan Phones
catan.subtitle: Mobile phone e-commerce · Freelance fullstack
catan.description: Production e-commerce, end-to-end. Spring Boot 4 backend with JWT auth and a self-initiated 9-point security audit. Next.js 16 + React 19 frontend with Gemini AI chatbot and hybrid checkout via WhatsApp and Instagram. Unified admin panel for online and in-store sales.

velour.name: Velour Fragancias
velour.subtitle: Perfume e-commerce · Freelance fullstack
velour.description: Full online store with catalog, persistent cart, order tracking and admin panel for both online and in-store sales. NextAuth.js v5, Prisma + Supabase, Gemini AI chatbot, Cloudinary, WhatsApp checkout. Vercel cron jobs, full SEO, rate limiting and bcrypt.

clinica.name: Management System — Nephrology Clinic
clinica.subtitle: Final degree project · 2024
clinica.description: Web system for patient management and medical history, with per-patient QR codes for quick access to medical info from mobile. Java + Spring Boot backend, SQL persistence and MVC architecture.

inventario.name: Inventory Management
inventario.subtitle: Full Stack · 2024
inventario.description: Web app with full product CRUD and stock control, client-server communication via REST APIs over a relational database. Angular + TypeScript frontend, Spring Boot backend.

bodega.name: Bodega Tittarelli
bodega.subtitle: Institutional e-commerce · Team · 2024
bodega.description: Institutional site with online store: authentication, cart and catalog. Collaborative work with Git/GitHub (branches, pull requests, code review).
